title: Built From Survival
studioRole: director, continuity supervisor, editorial compiler, finishing authority
assetFactoryRole: shot execution provider broker, provenance authority, budget gate, candidate QA, retry lineage
privateSourceAuthority: URAI Private Life Reference Canon — Master Archive
privacyRule: No private Drive IDs, Gmail source links, exact private addresses, restricted records, or personal account identifiers are committed to this public repository.

story.logline: A life shaped by pressure, rebuilding and relentless creation becomes the source material for UrAi, then UrAi turns that life back into a cinematic world.
story.coreThesis: A human life can become memory, memory can become structure, structure can become a world, and that world can become cinema.

sequences.purpose: repos, systems and spatial world emerge
memory becomes spatial and emotionally legible
working versus finished; visual iteration as credibility
show the real system and close on life becoming film

audioPolicy.preferredNarration: first-person Adam voice only when a separately authorized usable voice source or approved synthetic voice profile is available
audioPolicy.musicDirection: single evolving human theme expanding into cinematic scale

truthBoundaries: Generated imagery is cinematic recreation, not archival evidence.
Unresolved Army/Iraq, childhood, Puerto Rico/Caribbean and other source gaps remain unresolved rather than being falsely promoted as archive.
Sensitive legal, medical, government-ID and exact-address material is chronology evidence only unless separately authorized for production.
No pictured person is identified by facial resemblance.
promotionRule: No generated shot enters final editorial assembly until mandatory QA passes; no private master is called final until the complete film plays end-to-end without requiring verbal explanation of UrAi.
